videos.headline: JMU strikes first with 18-yard touchdown
videos.description: Ben DiNucci fires a long pass to Riley Stapleton for an 18-yard touchdown to put James Madison up 10-0 vs. Weber State.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (JMU strikes first with 18-yard touchdown) 2019/12/21 ESHEET

videos.headline: DiNucci's fake handoff fools everyone for TD
videos.description: Ben DiNucci fakes a handoff to Jawon Hamilton which fools nearly everyone on the field as DiNucci easily walks in for a one-yard touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (DiNucci's fake handoff fools everyone for TD) 2019/12/21 ESHEET

videos.headline: MacPherson's beautiful catch sets up Weber State's short TD
videos.description: Ty MacPherson hauls in a deep pass from Jake Constantine under pressure for a 37-yard gain. On the next play, Kevin Smith skips around the pile for a 2-yard Weber State touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (MacPherson's beautiful catch sets up Weber State's short TD) 2019/12/21 ESHEET

videos.headline: Stapleton hauls in improbable TD catch in final seconds of half
videos.description: Ben DiNucci puts the ball in the air as the clock hits zero and Riley Stapleton makes a great catch in traffic for a 34-yard touchdown to cap off the first half.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Stapleton hauls in improbable TD catch in final seconds of half) 2019/12/21 ESHEET
